question: Q4(b). Solve the recurrence T(n) = 3T(n/4) + n log n using the Master Theorem. State which case applies, verify any condition that case requires, and give the asymptotic bound for T(n).

referenceCriteria.label: Identifies the parameters
referenceCriteria.expects: States a = 3, b = 4 and f(n) = n log n.

referenceCriteria.label: Computes the critical exponent
referenceCriteria.expects: Computes n^(log_b a) = n^(log_4 3), approximately n^0.79.

referenceCriteria.label: Selects the correct case
referenceCriteria.expects: Identifies Case 3, because f(n) grows polynomially faster than n^(log_4 3).

referenceCriteria.label: Verifies the regularity condition
referenceCriteria.expects: Checks a·f(n/b) <= c·f(n) for some c < 1, e.g. 3·(n/4)·log(n/4) <= (3/4)·n log n.
